review_text: Not for tablets anymore?!! I've been using this app for years on my tablets, and it started glitching and locking up frequently, so I thought I'll uninstall it and reinstall it. I can't reinstall it. Google play says it's not compatible with tablets now and offers no other app in its place. why??! Now I'm stuck with the online website shopping experience, which is terrible! Customer service was a dead end. This will deter me from shopping on Amazon and may force me to cancel prime.

Can't access our orders for tracking anymore since the recent change. I do a search for my orders and it shows me shipping suggestions. I used to use the app primarily for keeping track of my orders because the web site makes it difficult to tell what's arriving on a particular day and the app used to sort them by the day expected. This was easy, user friendly, and wonderful. Now it's gone. I have no reason to use the app anymore. I can't easily track any packages anymore.

Terrible search algorithm: The app is almost unusable. I have tried and tried to use this site but as the years pass, the search becomes less and less capable. Even 15 years ago I could still use the filters as such. When I searched for an item today, the display photos were massive. Only one item is shown on the screen now. Not only can I not find the correct items, the wrong items take up the whole screen. My eyesight has not changed, nor has my ability to spell or know what I want to buy.

The Amazon app can be frustrating, especially during Prime Day and Black Friday, where pricing feels deceptive. Items are often marked up before being “discounted” making it seem like you’re getting a deal when you’re not. Cancelling Prime if you don't want it anymore is a hassle and customer support can be hit or miss. If you have an issue with an order sometimes you get the runaround or are told you’ve been refunded, only to find out you haven't forcing you to go through the process again.

Amazon has refused to address problems I first brought up years ago, and now they seem to WANT to be impossible to use. Between facing a disabled "continue" button at the payment options screen when paying with gift cards, not being able to buy Amazon gift cards anymore, having Visa cards repeatedly declined without explanation, and useless customer service, I've had my last straw. They've lost me as a customer and I'm deleting my account. This slow, janky app with no offline isn't any better.

This new update is a disaster. Nothing in my wishlist is in order, and there's no way to filter it for most recent items. Search brings up items totally unrelated to the keywords. Not to mention that nearly all orders that have been transferred to USPS disappear and get lost. I live a few miles from a distribution center. There's no reason to transfer them to the post office. Been a member for over 10 years. Disappointed with how things have turned out these last few years.

You have to click through like 5 different pages before you have the option to even speak to customer service. Nothing qualifies for return/replacement or refund. What's worse, Amazon moderates all the reviews, so you can't even warn others about anything. UPDATE: they've incorporated that stupid AI assistant bs, which will pop up with "suggested questions" every time you click on an item. And 80% of the time, it refuses to go away, making a part of your screen unusable. Utterly infuriating.

Until today, I have never had any problems with the app. However, today I can't choose options on an item. For example I select an item that can come in different colors. I checked for updates, and I updated. I cleared cache. I force stopped the app. Nothing has corrected the issue. If it corrects itself, I will edit this review.

Amazon offers a generally excellent customer experience, and I appreciate the convenience and range of products available. However, I have ongoing concerns regarding order fulfillment at the facility level. It seems that every few orders, there is an issue that requires me to contact customer service due to incorrect processing, delays, or errors in shipment. This not only creates inconvenience but also undermines the reliability I expect as a Prime member.

This is especially painful when shopping for niche items, where the sponsored ad doesn't match what I am looking for. I get Amazon is trying to squeeze profits from both ends. But it has gotten to the point where you can't even use the app to shop anymore. Unless you want one of the 3 sponsored brands.

I have no issues with app until recent. easy to shop and find recommendations based on what your looking for . I love being able to compare with similar items in same price range. App keeps crashing. Here's how i fixed it (Android). Go into phone settings, apps, find google chrome, uninstall updates to chrome. Then go to play store settings and turn off auto updates. Restart phone and your apps won't crash. Some people report uninstalling updates to system webview also works. Don't forget to undo all of this once they fix the bug.

EDIT: The following seem to have been fixed and app has been running smoothly for the last couple of months. Previously there were issues with freezing and crawling SO SLOWLY. It used to work fine for <30 minutes, then it was back to crawling/freezing. Felt like a denial of service attack. Was unable to edit my lists. I'm glad it's fixed. Here's to hoping you can keep the wrinkles ironed out and the app stays in working order.

Returns are frustrating, challenging, and inconsistent. Most of the time I order anywhere from 8 - 12 items, but may return 6 items. If I didn't love the clothing so much, I probably would not keep shopping through this platform.

Clothing is hit or miss, the endless"gifts" and spam that fills your screen and holds you hostage is annoying and it's not as it appears . It's a way of bullying you into purchasing quickly! I've been tricked too many times and purchased things I didn't need or want just for a deal. Also returns are tricky and like pulling teeth with them. cust serv. isn't terrible but I've had better. 4 stars is a good score and despite all these things I believe this app deserves it! kids clothes get 5 stars!

Shein is good. You have to get familiar with material and the different lines to know what's quality and what best fits your body type. Prices are great. Using the app itself is easy to navigate. I've not had many glitches. Just wish it would stop recommending me the same things over and over. Gave 4 stars because it's hard to address issues that arise. Customer service is mid.

I found several items with reasonable or even good prices but when I try to view the products details a spinning wheel comes up and wants me to install an app. I don't want to install an app I would just like to buy the product on sale on the internet. I'm sure that you are losing many customers who don't want to spend and spin and install and download. I just want to buy a bunch of men's clothes!

So far my daughter's and I have liked Shein. You can't beat their prices. However, the quality of the clothing is hit and miss. It seems like it's getting better. Also the sizes are not consistent. But when you click on the size it lists the measurements, so be sure to pay attention to that. Shipping is also hit and miss. Sometimes things will get here within the same week and sometimes it takes 2 weeks. But the bathing suits are super cute and cheap. Overall I would recommend shopping on Shein.

Overall I've had great experience! The clothes are inexpensive, in style and fit well. Room for improvement would be Customer Service. My 1st package was missing one (of many) shirts I ordered. Everything else was there but the tracking said it had been delivered and their records showed the item should have been in the package. No further search was done on it and no credit was ever issued. All in all it was only a few dollars, so I've continued shopping with them and have had great luck since.

Shein has a huge selection of discount clothing for all. in a wide variety of sizes, also housewares, office supplies, accessories. The reviews on the app can be really helpful, including true fit. Occasionally you can get something that doesn't fit the way you expected it to but the biggest problem I've had is receiving clothing that's not the fiber described. It does take a while to receive, but the return service has been great.

Shein is a great place to shop for people on a budget. They have some pretty good quality items for lower costs than Amazon or Walmart. I personally love their earring selection because of how fun and unique they are. Shipping is quite fast if you are able to pick expedited shipping, but like others have said, the tracking provided for packages isn't the best. Their customer service isn't great either. If you do end up buying something and not liking it, I recommend selling/giving it away

I recommend Shein to literally everyone. Out of 100s of items I've ordered I've been disappointed in maybe 3. I spent $90 and recieved 21 things. At the mall I spent $100 on 4 items of clothing. If that doesn't speak for the pricing, I don't know what does. The app is relatively easy to use, it makes buying from them and rating clothes better, I'd download if I were thinking about buying from them. And you should buy from them.

If you have ever used them on Windows, you know how frustratingly slow their website is. Their app is only slightly better. I love their products and prices but I wish they would improve the shopping experience. Sometimes I seriously consider not finishing my order. But I usually receive my orders in 7-10 days. Jeans, tops, jewelry, makeup, housewares, pet products, shoes, lingerie, bags. Women, men, children and home shopping.

I ordered 5 pieces. All came, but the shipping was a little slow. I ordered two of the same swimsuit but in different colors. One was exactly as I expected, but the bottoms to the other were extremely cheeky. I also ordered a shirt and the material was not what was described and it was detailed slightly different than expected. However, everything else was great. My order came in 12 days.

App works well, company is hit or miss. Everything else I ordered I have received, but currently waiting on one that hasnt updated any shipping information in a week, like it just disappeared, nervous about trying to get that. Clothes are either really good or really bad. Reviews help some, but not always. Points disappear without warning. Use them asap or lose them.

I love the easy navigation of the app, the set up is easy and most of the clothes I have gotten from Shein have actually fit and are good quality. The only problem I have is the customer service portion. It's NONEXISTENT!!!!! You cannot reach a human being to resolve your issues. Basically if you have an issue with returns, package tracking, etc. you are SOL.

Most clothes are decent quality. I have only ever bought items if they have several reviews with pictures. I have t been able to find a swimsuit that works, even using the proper measurements. The only reason I didn't give a 5 star review is because it takes forever to earn points, they aren't worth very much, and they expire after a certain amount of time.

I love the free shipping, I refuse to use the wish app because they charge shipping for each item. SHEIN's products come as they look. The fabric tends to be thinner than the photos look' but for the price I can't complain! Fast shipping. Clothes tend to run a little small so i would recommend buying one size up. But otherwise it's a great way to buy clothes on a budget.

I really like Shein , I've never got any clothes , but will reconsider. You get free coupons , and if you get make or get any likes on your review , you get points to use during checkout . Not only that they have petite , medium , and plus sizes , if you don't ever see your size you could leave your size in a feedback. Very fun and would definitely catch your attention. (I'm still shopping for stuff , even though I don't have any money 😭😭)

I really love the app and the way the interface looks, it's very easy to navigate what you want to look for. I do however wish that some of the clothing options were labeled as petite or if they even sell petite clothing. I am under 5ft and it can be frustrating at times to purchase a 'mini' dress and expect that since I purchase an xs or small, that it would come above the knee, and often times it doesn't. Other than that, the clothes are cute and I love the app

I love this app. The clothes are inexpensive and they have a lot of options for plus size people. The material of the clothing is great as well. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the length of the sleeve of some tops are not long enough for tall people. I am 5'7" and have long arms. Some of the long-sleeved shirts I have purchased from this app have been too short. They stop about 2-3 inches above my wrist. I just roll them up and use them as half sleeve shirts.

Love shopping online and it's super easy to shop, so many options and you get the quality you pay for. Big dislike that they do not have customer service, I made a boboo on the address didn't add the apartment and they notified me about this once shipped but no way to fix it as you can't contact them. Still hoping I'll get my items, spent almost $350 in clothes.

The shipping is fast and the clothing is fairly cheap! The material is decent but has a bit of an icky feeling to it. Not the best if you have sensory issues. There is a wide variety of clothes from standard chic styles, cottage core, and even e-fashion! It may be hard to locate clothes of your taste when searching through the popular picks but even so the recommendations are a good way to go. Overall a great place to shop to upgrade your wardrobe without worrying about a hole in your pocket.

The clothing can occasionally have manufacturing errors and the material isn't the most comfortable in the universe, but for the price it's PHENOMENAL. It was a real life saver when we got slammed with a hear wave right after buying a house. I was able to get swims, tanks, tops, and shorts without breaking the bank. It's hot girl summer on a budget!

I like the app, & it has so many unique items at great prices! But I can no longer check in unless I get a notification. I am signed up for check in notifications, but I rarely get them. Why is there no longer an option to check in on the app? I was relying on points to get my kids Christmas presents & now Idk what I'm going to do. Plz fix this.

I'm liking the clothes I've ordered so far & that shocked me! also the shipping was surprisingly fast! only took 2 day's. I didn't like what they did when I had to cancel a item in my order. They said if I canceled that they would either only give me store credit or they'd have to cancel the whole order?? that made no sense at all why couldn't I just get my money refunded. I tried to use the exchange option but it wouldn't work. Three days later & still haven't got any refund back.

I've order twice using the app so far. I love it! I wish their labeling system was more organized (ex: all the holographic item come up when 'hologrplaphic' is typed, also similar/ same jewelry pieces in gold and silver are named differently) ither than that, they have really cute clothes for very low prices. Shipping has come early than expected on both of my previous orders.

It was AMAZING!There was a lot of things in SHEIN, there were clothes, phone cases, toys, stickers, led lights, decoration, bracelets, hair accessories, and many more things! I love this app. Most of the things there were CHEAP! U can put the things u like or want in a list and u can order it some time later, it will save it for u, but some things can get sold out. Some things will have a size or color so u can pick out either a color or a size! I love this app and i hope u love it as well !♡

Love everything about SheIn!! But lately the app keeps timing out and asking me to log in again. It's especially frustrating cuz I just started playing the games available. Also as a PSA the games so far haven't paid off. I invite people who accept the invite and get really close then the game isn't available anymore. I'm finishing up the ones I'm still playing to see how they go and will update my review once these games have ended. I'm sure it's impossible to actually win anything!!

It's good but the packages come as if they have been thrown around every which way and sometimes stink, also do not order a lot of things at once and expect it to come fast, it will come most likely a month after. Other than that the products itself is good. Also the products plus tax are not cheap, the product itself is cheap but the tax makes you second guess buying what you want basically...they clickbait you.

Theres not just clothing on here! Theres home decor and makeup. Everything is suprisingly cheap for how good looking the clothes are, and the material is good as well! New things come in often. The only thing I dont like is the shipping, I live in the us so yes its going to take a long time to get here, it usually takes 3 weeks while amazon comes in less than a week, other than that SHEIN is a great app and its by far my favorite shopping app!!!

I would have given this 5 stars but there are few things I would change before I would. See, it's annoying when your points get taken away over time. It's sometimes hard to add them up if they keep disappearing lol. That is my most recent concern. Everything else on this app is helpful! I love to buy clothes from here and even some stationary they have! I would get the app if you are sick of going online to get to it all of the time, plus you get more points.

I recommend most clothing items on Shien except the swim wear. The swimwear isn't inclusive. I ordered bikini tops in a large and recieved them in a small. Despite this, the items are good quality and are sold at an affordable price. The return process is also painless. There are lots of discounts. I personally enjoy the favorites page. It doesn't delete an item you like simply because it sold out. It gives you the option of finding similar items and notifies when your liked item is in stock.

So far I've purchased $300 of clothes from here. Everything is great for the most part and for the price. Sizing and colors have been accurate. Some items lack of quality despite the excellent reviews you might see on them (Thin, see-through, tears easy, bleeds dye) despite the excellent reviews you might see on them, but I guess that's just what you get for the price on some items. Overall I'm happy with what I've got.

I love the variety and reasonable pricing. So far all the clothes and even electronics have been great quality. My only issues are the tracking and the customer service features. I just received an order but I was never shown an email that said it shipped It still shows "processing" in the app. And when I tried to ask for help I didn't really get a solution and was redirected back into the app to square one.

I've never had a problem with any of my orders and everything I've bought looked as shown in the pictures. So far I've received 2 free gifts earned playing the puppy keep game. However, that game is extremely annoying. It's very glitchy & slow, sometimes kicks me back to main page before I'm done, it seems the more I play it the longer they drag it out. They have given me extensions on the time though so that was nice. But some days I think this is taking so long I don't even care any more.

Nice app to buy hair accessories, summer dresses, Keychains, little earrings, and random knickknacks. The prices are really good compared to other stores. For example a set of hairclips here could be 4$ and at the store its like 12$. It has really good deals. Only thing is the total in your cart changes when you're about to confirm purchase. It rises a few $ above what was expected but nothing major. I just hope they fix that.

Great selection of products. Something to fit everyone's needs and taste. Inexpensive. Shein changed up their buying and shipping and return process. It can be confusing and a bit of a nightmare. The price of shipping is usually free or reasonably priced. But the return process is where it becomes annoying. Initial returns are still free. But products come in from everywhere instead of in a single package. The return process gets all scrambled here. Not enough to miss a bargain.

I've bought 5 items on shein (waiting for 4 more) and I haven't had a bad order yet. From what I've seen, the clothes are super cute and good quality. Sometimes the pictures dont match the product, so always check the reviews. And then understand that sometime the cheaper stuff might not be of the best quality, because you get what you pay for. Overall though I've been really satisfied with their service

The price and variety of styles at Shein are great. They're leading the pack with the "one- on-one" with their customers. From their Live Shopping experiences to daily flash sales, you will be intrigued at what is to happen next. Their customer service represenatives are one of the best. I do recommend them if shopping on a budget. They only lack of few things. Irregularity of clothing, does happen. And unavailabilty of sizes does as well. In which could happen at any "newer" company.

The app is really good, good items, prices and deals but the only things i think they can fix are: 1) Allow us to select what we want to pay for from the cart. I always have to send some of the items to the wishlist in order to make a payment for the items i have pickep. 2) Allow us to change the size of the items after making the payment if they haven't been shipped yet.

I'm enjoying every bit of my shopping experiences from this app. The down side of the app is changing price of the items within minutes of adding them to your cart. Take for example, when you find an item for $7 and add it to your cart, and you keep adding other items too so that you can check out multiple items at a goal but only to discover most of the prices of the good changes before you are ready to check out I have this experience more than twice and I keep wondering it the app is a scam.

I absolutely LOVE Shein!!! The sizes are slight off in some cases but you're allowed to return item to get better size which is awesome! *1st suggestion would be allowing users to follow their friends. I would love to surprise friends with gifts from Shein that I saw on their wishlist. *2nd suggestion recycle more of your items. Some are sold out and never seen to return :( The cost of items and delivery time is superb! I driveline told and showed my friends & family about it! They joined too!

Impressed with the quality of the clothing considering the price. Cute stuff, fast shipping. The only thing is that its a hit and miss kinda thing. But that happens even when you buy things off the rack, not everything you thought would look cute you'll like when you try it on, and not everything fits even if it is in your size. But they have free returns so no complaints here. I odered a bunch of stuff and kept 3 items because of the length or the material being too see through or size.

I had very good experience with shein. You really need to pay attention to the sizes underneath then they tell you (preference inches or cm) of each size. Also reviews are helpful to get an idea of the material, size, fit, comfort. Not everything is a deal, sometimes you will see things that you can get at other places for cheaper but other than that I would recommend the app.

Easy to use app, great pricing. Item descriptions are pretty accurate, pics are sometimes a little misleading (especially if you don't look like the model) but that's why I always go to the reviews and see pics posted by customers. I wish more items were cotton/cotton blends but I know they're cheap because they're all polyester. Returns are easy and delivery is quite fast, comparable to delivery times of most any other retailer I've ordered from (Macy's, Kohl's, etc).

I've been pretty happy with most of my purchases. But things can be hard to find after a 1st look if you don't click the heart to save it. I wish they'd add categories for saving things instead of lumping together. I do wish they would quit letting people do those nonsensical reviews just to get points... Such as posting song lyrics, a bunch of symbols, etc. And adding a thumbs down option for reviews would be great. But otherwise, I order from them fairly regularly and will continue to do so.

I love this app! I could browse through it for hoursss!!! They have THE best selection of online plus size clothing I've ever came across & all of it is extremely affordable. They also have lookbooks & so many other cool app features like contests, wishlists, styling tips, you name it. The only con I've noticed is that, some not all, of their clothing isn't of the best quality. But it's not like a hit or miss, it's more like a few & very far in between kind of thing.

Wonderful clothing and affordable. Takes a while to come to your address, & need to order one size bigger for womens' shirts and dresses. However, I've heard it is better to order one size smaller on pants and shorts. I haven't ordered those items yet. The material is rather thin, but cute! Overall, I was pleased and I'm still ordering clothing through them! Hope this helped!

The app is very easy to use from purchasing, to reviewing, tracking and returns. The only complaint which isn't a complaint is there are a lot of push notifications and when searching (this goes for the website as well) for something specific the tags are off so there is a lot of merchandise that customers aren't accessing it could be bc they are adding items but the thousands but it would be great if searching for specific items they all presented versus having to do a week long search daily.

Great App for finding cute clothes at a super low price, although it is still a 'Fast-Fashion' brand which is a negative. Shipping times are also relatively long, it took 4 weeks to recieve one item I had purchased. One of my favorites things about this app is the ability to earn points by playing games and completing certain activities within the app, if you are consistent you can eventually win enough points that you can then use during checkout to take more than 70% off of your order!

Always, always! check the size chart for the item you want. Not all sizes are exact even across similar items. The site is easy to navigate. I like that they also suggest similar items. I'm primarily looking at wedding dresses right now, but I did order a jumpsuit and some tube tops (so I can tan without strap lines for the wedding). I had to return the jumpsuit bc it was just a tad small. But it and the tube tops were good quality.

Like all the variety of products & prices for the most part. Have had good luck with customer service. Just don't like how often I get notifications and emails from Shein. Sometimes get about 8 a day. I would prefer only having to look at the site when I want to look for something, or at least only getting one message a day. Most of the time, I end up just getting upset with all the interruptions, and end up deleting them, wthout even looking at them. Too time consuming, and battery drain

The app is easy to use, has a lot of different items to chose from, ways to get points, and videos showcasing fashion and Sheglam application tips. The prices are great! Some of the downsides are I am plus size and almost all of the plus size is modeled by people that are mostly on the skinnier side. They don't have truely plus sizes for men either. Most of the fashion is great, but there are a lot of crop tops, wish there was a choice on regular or crop.

I randomly found Shein as a shipping app while looking for a specific style of boot. I downloaded the app because I saw a bunch of cute styles for great prices. I thought it was going to be like wish and take forever with the shipping and the price of shipping. It didn't I found really cute items for affordable prices and they even let me break down my purchase into 4 installment payments without a credit check and shipped them immediately.. Shein is great! I can't wait to get my new items.

Shein (selectively) offers the On-Time delivery awards. Items have been delayed and I now get .50 cents compared to the $5 we receive in the past. This option is also not automatically selected, so please make sure you select before checking out. On checkout, watch out for the Click-On "use deal", it automatically uses your points saved and coupons. Hidden fees also depend on your items shipping method (Like Quickship) or vendor, so watch out! I still very much enjoy Shein.

I like the app over all. I do wish there was no board & item amount on boards limits. Because of that I'm leaving off a star. Why limit customers boards/items they want. With such great products & prices, you'd think they'd want to make many boards & save many items. Also if you're going to be limiting, you shouldn't count items on boards that have been sold out as part of the limit. 100 boards & 100 items per a board. Not enough... and why limit it?

I give it 4 stars for the simple fact that you never really know what to expect when you order.. It's Always best to read reviews, look at submitted photos from buyers and compare (look for people who are closer to your own body height and weight, look at the measurements (having measured for your own sizes prior) and check for whether it has been rated too big, too small, or true to size, etc., prior to making ANY purchase! When you do that, you can make some really great judgment calls!

I have ordered a few times and everything has been as the pictures show. It might not look as good as it does on the model, but it is the same lol I have also made a return and it was an easy process. I love how you can earn points just by checking in each day and for rating your items and then use the points as money towards anotherorder. They also usually always have coupons available and free shipping when you spend a certain amount. Overall a great app!! Only downfall is you keep spending 🤣

honestly you can find really nice quality things on here. You need to read the reviews on the product you are looking at before getting buying it. Sometimes you'll need to size up or size down, I have only had one item I didnt enjoy and that was my fault because I didnt fully read the sizing on it before buying it, it was just way to big. I buy from Shein regularly, and it's usually a big haul. I will always recommend their bathing suits. So diverse!

In my opinion, Shein is a great app and I have ordered from it a few times! The quality is great for its price, and I love how the stuff is cheaper than other stores which increases people buying it. The app is good itself, but I have heard rumors about how they are animal cruelty, use animal products, test on animals, which, DONT GET ME WRONG! Is horrible and if that didnt happen I think it would be a 5 star review. I think it is an amazing shopping app and I still reccomend!! Thank you SHEIN!!

4 stars nothing of their fault, I'm simply new to the ap & store and haven't had a chance to see what all it offers. However it seems to be a very convenient app to use so far. I absolutely love their clothes & even more I absolutely love love love their prices. Very affordable with so many different looks & styles. This is quickly becoming my go to store. And has been the sole cause of my starting to shop online more than in person. U cld say I've transitioned from in store shopping to online!

The customer support is also top notch. You get what you see. Love that people can show reviews of how the clothes fit them and you can filter reviews. It helps a ton. Also love the daily point that goes to your purchase. Annoyed the 20% off is no longer a thing for orders at $69. It's 15% now. Also annoyed that I don't get my full points when reviewing ever. It's always least 40 points off even though do 3 photos and over 20 words. The tracking is on point and great though.

I like how it's simple and everything is a great price as long as you don't look at the actual expense stuff. The material for clothes is good, but always check the size because they are slightly smaller, especially children's clothes. the thing I don't get is the free stuff because it's not actually free if you can't share it with a friend, and it's always 1 cent left. Also, the ads of the free spins when you open the apps do get annoying sometimes, but the coupons work. I like that.

I had a great experience shopping on SHEIN. The clothes are very trendy and affordable, which makes it easy to keep up with fashion without spending too much. My order arrived on time, and everything looked just like the pictures. The sizing was mostly accurate, and I appreciated the customer reviews that helped me choose the right fit. I will definitely be ordering again!

I’m obsessed with the products and the prices are usually a total steal, but SHEIN—can we talk about the price gymnastics? Puppy keep game is good, the closer you get to completing the less you get for feeding but end up getting a free item every 4-5 months. search results could be better and more refined the 3 day delivery/local delivery filter has stopped working! reviews are a good way of deciding on if a product is for you as others are able to leave pics so you can decide. would be better if the filter for reviews was expanded, so I could narrow down by size as well as pics.

i enjoy the items on this app in pretty much every category, only thing is when they offer you the 10 Free items its almost as if its false advertising because they will confirm that the items are being packed and shipped and they verify your name, address all that then when you think your actually so lucky and so happy about these so called 10 "FREE" ITEMS THEY MAKE YOU JUMP THROUGH LOOP HOLES and invite 3 people who want absolutely NOTHING TO DO WITH SHEIN!!! you don't get them smh it's unfair

Lots of cute stuff. Prices are cheap. Quality isnt the best but far from the worst(you get what you pay for.). Clothing does run big. They do have some petite, xxs and xs items. They also offer curvy fit items too.

love their plus size clothes really read their descriptions though so you are getting the right sizes they have different shape sizing too and they have a curvy+ which is 5x and up! I get a lot of my clothes there. and there is only 1 box store that I go to now for clothes there are just something I have to try on before buying.

This swimsuit is adorable. I bought a medium, usually wear a 4 or 6 and it was too large and too long. If it didn't have a seam sewn along the bottom, I would just order a smaller size and cut it to make it shorter. if you're looking for full coverage, I would suggest sizing down and buying this one.

I love Shein! The prices are awesome. I purpose never to spend over 15.00 for any one Item. This works well for me, because there are always wonderful clothes priced below this amount. Shein has trending fashions with quality materials on sale always. The best thing is that I can dress nice for a reasonable price. I love that I can pay in four payments too! I wish the shipping didn't take so long.

I have loved all but 2 things I have ordered over the years. I have bought about 17 things. Of the 2 things, one was not the size I ordered and the other was a pair of earrings that looked very different from the picture. These things happen, but my problem is that no matter how I tried, returning or getting a refund was impossible. I have friends who have managed this but even with their help, still impossible. I only shrug it off as these things are so cheap. Love it otherwise

the material was good and all but it comes in a set size you can't upscale at all, at least not as far as I saw. it's comfy on the legs but if you're a bigger girl like I am, this specific brand I wouldn't recommend. it doesn't go past the upper thighs. if you're a size or two smaller than me though it would be perfect. all in al, liked the product, just sad it doesn't come in a larger size.

I love shein for the most part, but there's an issue with the cart. Things keep being unselected in my cart. I'll put an order through, then see that everything didn't go through. I've been using shein for a while and its got really reasonable pricing, the only complaint i have is the import tax is ridiculous. if I want free shipping that's already costing a lot for the items in my cart only for that amount to be doubled plus the tax to the factories. I understand having an import tax but having it be 50% is ridiculous.

There's a lot going on! I found it a little overwhelming, but I survived! I just wanted to add more items to my cart but The appl was freaking out about coupons that didn't even apply to my order. It was weird. I hope that doesn't continue to be an issue because I like shopping on this app.

bad vision and some of the writing is very small and very faint and I cannot zoom in. also the address finder did not have my location and my wife has used this website multiple times. good prices love everything else but not good for the visually impaired

I would've given a 5-star review if you didn't need to go into the clothing details every time to see which material the piece of clothing is made out of. Previous orders were very well received. Their Jeans and bags quality, materials, sizes and packaging were very good. Hope that my current orders are also well received. The products quality, materials, sizes are also very satisfactory. Thank you all bosses for your help, delivery and services in advance. Hope to receive all my products in good condition soon. It's got deals on items that would cost more or be too hard to find in person. I can shop conveniently from my device without having to go anywhere. My size is very popular but it can be easily found and fitted through this store. Shein is realistic.

I have had a good experience with Shein, I am happy with the clothes I ordered for the price, most of the clothes are true to size. I am returning a few things due to sizing seems pretty simple. I recommend them (don't expect high quality their not Macy's) and I will order again.

Cheap Chinese knock off's covering everything you can think off and often things you would never think off. Some items are good quality and a real bargain, others are a complete waste of money. The app itself is not so bad. But the overall experience is pretty bad. Search results are misleading. Shows what look like great low prices, but click to purchase and it's suddenly more expensive. Product is ok but the company needs better return refund service before I never had a problem I order a lot of stuff but have backed off buying so much so to complications on getting refunded they want way to much work from you and information and pictures etc .

Lots of cool stuff, most of it quite reasonably priced, and some of it super cheap. Shipping is usually cheap, too. The app is overall very amazing it can sometimes be a hit or miss kind of shopping app but I have enjoyed almost all of the products I have bought for the low prices that are offered. Just received my first purchase. It's not Amazon when it comes to shipping, but what can you expect from China!? Items are often very inexpensive, and you often get what you pay for (low quality). Overall great and fun. It's a good app. There is room for improvement tho, like product listing it shows the price of item, I would like to see the shipping price also listed next to the cost. If you can handle the longer shipping speeds which are understandable given various circumstances then you'll have no problem finding what you need and being happy with the end result.

My overall experience with AliExpress is a 4/5. You have to be careful with particular sellers and check ratings, pictures, etc: however, any issues have been taken care of by the Ali team in a rapid fashion. It is sad that the prices of many products have gone up within the last year. Some items I can already purchase in the states for the listed price. I would not wait a month to order and recieve my item. Long story short: if the price is right and the seller is reliable it's a WIN!

Great place to shop. Been using it for years. I'm pretty I was probably an early adopter. Some hiccups have come along with the Plus and Choice options. I hope they're hiccups and not intentional. AliExpress is an effective way to connect a manufacturer directly to the customer with reasonable deals for products that are similar in quality to beans names items. However, using the app is not without risk. If purchasing an item from a seller that other does not have very many reviews or is relatively new, there is always the potential for a scam. Likewise, all sellers are motivated to have their payments released from escrow, and if you take their assurances at face value then prepare to be ghosted when the window for opening a dispute closes. However, most products that are well-reviewed should be satisfactory when they eventually arrive through the mail. So, if you are willing to do your homework and shop around as much as possible for something that you actually want and are ready to wait a long time to get it, then this service is recommended as you can score some good deals that you'll never see locally unless it's on clearance.

We have a new shopping app!!!!! Great quality, the shirt was a little late but even though everything went through customs the kids had a great Christmas with the gifts. Wonderful on the price I spent. Yes, I am planning on shopping this app some more.

variable response to advertisements, with some arriving quickly with no difficulties : some significantly later or not at all., MUST review product descriptions accurately as the wording sometimes is structured to support a misconception of what the product actually is. I've recently been buying things from AliExpress and for the most part I am satisfied. Very good with great offer especially regarding affordable electronics but sometimes you need to spend a lot of time with customer service agents to report damaged or missing goods. AliExpress is the perfect site to find all kinds of items. Every once in a while I've had problems where an item didn't arrive or something like that but I've always been able to work it out with the seller and receive a refund when that happens. Almost all of my orders arrive in great shape and on time.

Great place to go for inexpensive products, if you can wait the month that it takes for things to ship. I frequently use AliExpress as an alternative to Amazon if I don't need something right away. You can almost always find products for cheaper than you would buying them locally or in the US, and quality is almost never an issue since practically everything is made in China now anyway. The few times that something I ordered didn't ship on time, I was quickly refunded without any issues.

Great app!! Easy to use! I would recommend reading reviews on products and check for the best price. Also look at the stores overall rating. Usually even if they are just starting out they want their products and overall review to be good. I have bought several things from this app. And I wouod say overall I am 99% satisfied. All of the sellers I have bought from have communicated with me. you have to expect occasional mistakes. Most of the time they will reach out and try to make things right.

Never had issues receiving items when orders go through. I've returned about 5 items and always got money back. My main feedback or feature request. For the coin deals, please add option to select other options from the selected item. For example, like a different color fishing lure. There's plenty of times the coin deal were great but I didn't pull the trigger because I didn't want 3 of the same color fishing lures. This will help with coin usage as well for folks that gather coins.

Honestly a great app if you're planning to buy STATIONERY items such as notepads, washi tapes, stickers, pencils and the like. I would not recommend buying ELECTRONICS on here as I feel those are most likely to get scammed in a way. Other than that I've bought jewelry, dolls, uv resin (and silicone molds), and stationery items. I've recieved all my orders and have recieved my refunds on some with no problem.

Exceptional! No Issues @ All I was skeptical @ first but decided to give it a try. The products I purchased most come in "travel size" Still it makes sense, the prices are extremely low and lots to choose from. I'm definitely going to be ordering whenever I can. So many items to choose from! Very happy customer and will be long term as long as my experience remains this way, with purchases.

I buy clothes, accessories and cosplay stuff through this app. Very easy to use, and app will curate recommended items for you based on your search. Choose your sellers wisely, and you'll find great deals and quality items. There's few bugs in coin mini games. Price have gone up, but it's less than Amazon - you just have to wait bit for them to arrive.

Ordered eight items, thus far. I highly suggest that you carefully read the product description. I did order two items that were not what I expected, when they arrived. I went back and reread the descriptions and they were as advertised. The mistakes were 100% my mistake. So just be careful. Other than that, the other six items were exactly what I expected.

I have only 1 issue. I wish vendors would put shipping costs on search results page. It is wasting my time to go to a listing and see the shipping costs are costly compared to the price of the item. Thanks for listening. One more thing is if you paid for an item and the vendor never sends and you don't get your money or product.

AliExpress is great for shopping online for quality products at reasonable prices. Shipping is much better than wish, I haven't tried returns or refunds yet tho... So far, I am very pleased with the app, the "coupons" are kinda confusing but I've gotten several discounts today by using them. I may edit my review as I placed many orders for different things today....we shall see if everything is of good quality and worth purchasing regardless of how low the price is.

So far I only made 2 orders. What I learned is it is better than TEMU, as it doesn't constantly ask you to share, but has similar items. The trick is to read the descriptions and find choice items, if they are not choice, they charge extra for shipping. But if you can be patient and read, it's definitely worth it.

It took me about a year and a half to take that first leap into the AliExpress shopping world but I am pretty satisfied with everything and am super excited to receive the products I've ordered and they even have a trial products where you can apply to receive the item and for free and they will send it to you and they just ask for an honest review so that's pretty cool too I don't think I've seen another site that does that but I'm not sure completely on that. I'm just excited AliExpress does!

I love that you can view actual photos of the product from previous purchasers to get a real image of the product versus a biased studio shot. There is plenty of feedback from other buyers on many items. Prices on many items are very competitive and I do not mind waiting a couple of weeks for certain items to get free shipping. A great global online marketplace.

I was not sure about using the products because i felt it would all be like the $1.00 stores. But it's not nor is it a hit or miss i expected either. I've had a horrible time however with the camera video doorbells. The sellers are very good to work with, however. The camera videos will really need some twickling. Just research the items our you will wait a long time and be disappointed. But there are also some good deals.

Good app. I notice that many reviews are not reviewing the app, but the service they got through aliexpress. Though I know some people have had problems, I never have. Pay attention to the reviews of who you order from. And the app, itself, is a good one so far (disclaimer: I make my orders through the website, not the app).

I'm in love with AliExpress, especially as it's a somewhat more practical alternative to Amazon, and the selection scale is much broader, more suppliers locally, depending on what you're shopping for. I buy for everything: home, work, gifts, supplies inventories, etc. My only peeve is I can't cash out my earned points for prizes within pricing, tax, and shipping totals; I'm just not able to at all. It keeps me from impulse buys-retail therapy, but not good for necessities and working supplies.

I've been shopping this app for over a year now and I've always had a great experience. If I was at all disappointed, they made it right. I have continuously recommended this app to several people. Yes the shipping takes a little longer than some places but the products are cheap and of good value!!! (When I mean I've used this app for a year, that means SEVERAL items I've ordered. More than once a week.

This app is great If you like getting cheap things in the mail. I get mostly nail polishes from here. If you read the reviews carefully you can find some treasures for cheap I got a pair of winter boots for like 10 or 13 bucks total and I've used them for 2 years and only 1 strap broke but there are 3 and the middle one broke so it isnt even noticable . Also if you dont get your mail which unfortunately does happen you can easily contest and get your money back. Downside takes forever to receive

Love this app so much, biggest highlight of my life since the pandemic! I have gotten mostly better deals on clothes, accessories, and shoes from here than at actual stores in the US for the same quality, if not even better! The one downside to this app is that you can't really return any products you buy (just like with the real vendors I've met overseas in person on the streets), and that each order takes a LONG time to arrive. Otherwise, I haven't needed to shop at the mall anymore!

Fun and Affordable Legit Shopping. AliExpress is a reputable company, unlike temu. This is a good app for finding products at a discount as long as you don't mind that they arrive by slow boat from China. This is not Prime, you can't get it tomorrow, unless maybe if you choose US shipping, where products cost a bit more. Buy "choice" products for better shipping rates and buyer protection. Use digital Aliexpress "coins" to get even more discounts. Earn coins by checking in each day. Addictive!

This was originally written in 2017: I find good quality products at great prices for the most part. It's a learning experience on sizing and waiting because shipping is often a long time wait. Some things have been timely though, and usually the savings is worth the wait for me. Occasionally there has been a dispute and that can be an unsatisfactory loss. Most of the sellers are very nice though and do work things out. Still holds true today Dec. 30, 2020

this is a very fun and inexpensive Makeup app to learn and play with! keeping in mind what you pay for a product is what you will receive, for example if you pay a dollar for an eyeshadow palette expect cheap makeup results. I would recommend this app if you were just starting out with makeup and would like to try a wide variety of items before you settle on purchasing from expensive and top-of-the-line professional makeup brands. I have bought several different items and would recommend!

The price is right!!! Shipping is not as great as it once was. I just wish tracking were a little more detailed. I order ALOT (2 -3 times a week)! I have only had 1 package not show up. It was refunded, but I don't know if it got lost on the American side or the Chinese side. If the tracking stated which country the package is in, then I can pinpoint and understand the delays (like LA burning, inclement weather, holidays) and better determine if I need to ask for a refund or wait a lil longer.

I've been ordering from Aliexpress for over 8 years and I have yet be disappointed with any purchase I have made. The app has never disappointed me, it's easy to use and the filters help to narrow down which store to purchase from. Majority of the stores are asian based but they have some distribution centers in the U.S and the sellers are all nice and quick to fulfill orders.

So Far So Good!! I like the app a lot! Easy to navigate, search, save & more. I like the products & pricing is great. I love how I can save items in my car, & pick & select what I want to purchase, without having to empty my whole cart to a wishlist I will forget about. So I can select certain items & buy them when I can afford too, & what I can't is all still in my cart for next time! My only issue is I get alerts for huge discounts "in my cart", but I can never find them when I go looking.

I love this app. However, I have rarely looked without spending a little money. I try to shop wisely, especially these days with limited income and even more, it seems,, limited believability ... not to mention deliveries. But, it has been my experience that with all of my orders ... on this app ... what you see IS what you get. AND, it has been my experience also, at these amazing prices, what you get is often much more than what you expect. And, returns are relatively easy.

I've ordered a few things from them, they're always good. Descriptions are accurate but don't read things into it. Shipping is ~4 weeks total. Two tablets got stuck in customs for a month, everything else has been much faster. Everything has been packaged very well, but it comes in a plastic bag which is sometimes a bit worse for the wear. Everything critical or fragile is always heavily sealed in bubble wrap; non-fragile things aren't as well packed, but keychains and such are already durable.

Ordered some tarot cards I haven't been able to find since they were originally sold at the mall back when I was 15-16 years old, and at half price!! My order came a week sooner then expected and they automatically allowed me to track my order as it was being shipped. My order amount was held in pending status until I received my order. 5 stars for quality product and services!!! Outstanding job!!!

Great app thats full of a variety of stores that have nice things that are at a great deal!! This is definetely a what u see is what u get type deal when ordering from this app! Only problem for me is the delivery is very slow! I'm still waiting on some items but I'll know for future reference on when to order in a timely manner. Thanks!

Thru the years I have ordered many items from AliExpress. While, like most sites, I might have received an item that is below par, I would still recommend them as I have been VERY happy with about 95% of what I've ordered. It's an EXCELLENT place to find what you want,what you collect, or just some- thing unique. Mostly great prices with free shipping on some items & reason- able shipping on others. Just saying.....

So far so good... Well I had to change from 4 stars to 5. I've been happy with everything I've purchased, the prices are amazing, and my orders have been on time every time. No crazy long waiting time for delivery either. If it says 11 days to get to you that's exactly how long it takes. The only thing I would change is how many coins I could use to purchase a product. Like if I could pay for the entire item/s with only the coins I've accumulated. I like free stuff, what can I say😉. 😁👍

Amazing qualify products for super cheap! Thought it was too good to be true but had to try it before assuming i was right. I'm HAPPY to admit I was completely Wrong! They have amazing products, with a HUGE variety of items. Everyone can find something they like and want. Actually they'll probably find a bunch of items they want which is great. Go ahead and let everyone have a shopping spree! It would be reasonable to buy 14 things for $25 and uaually free shpping.

I'm a new customer to Ali Express, so far, I like how the payment doesn't post to seller until buyer receives the order in good condition, protecting buyer and seller at the same time. I do use PayPal for my transactions with Ali Express that's something to consider. Delivery processing does take close to a month to two months but it's very understandable due to customs. Pricing of their items are very reasonable too. Love to shop here. :)

Using this app is *much* better than using the website! I've had no issue buying from AliExpress over the past year+. It's a great source of sewing & crafts supplies and household items for less. It's important to pay attention to the detaills, but that's true no matter where you shop. Some items have per-piece shipping costs, but the same or similar items are often available from other sellers, who ship free. There's usually a few weeks' wait for delivery, but the savings are worth it to me.

Excellent experience! I ordered a hard to find Rainbow High doll. It was about a third of the price than on other market apps. It arrived extremely fast. It was to arrive anywhere from the 12th to the 20th, and I received it on the 12th. It was packed with extreme care and arrived perfect. Just pay attention to the listing to make sure you're getting what you want. They are very transparent on branded and non-branded items, so just pay attention to the listing. I highly recommend AliExpress!

This is a great app, Can find most anything your looking for and even find some things you didn't know you needed... LoL... The prices are good on most items and you can look for other sellers that may have a lower price, I like that you can get a refund if the price of what you ordered has lowered within 30 days of ordering and you get the difference in credit... I recommend the AliExpress app...

If you're able to spend the time to research and compare products to one another, you can clearly see the killer deals on things that'd you would normally pay 2-3 times more for on other shopping apps! I've ordered about ~20 items give or take. Items ranging between $0.99-to-$180 and I've never had any bad or questionable experiences, and the things that I ordered more often than not arrived being much high quality than I was expecting by looking at the photos on the site. I'd recommend!!

I've always enjoyed the endless selection with Aliexpress. If course your gunna get a few dingy or knock off products, and some of the sellers aren't always the easiest to work with. But overall there are alot of great sellers, with great communication, and great products. I would definitely reccomend this wholesale site over any other wholesale site. I've been using it for years, it's my go too if I cant find something on Amazon, and many times it's worth the wait.

It's fixed. That mess went on for about 2-3 days and then started working properly. I like the app. Apart from that, I have had no problem with it. Pages load fast, pics are detailed and show views of the item from different angles, and there are LOTS of them. Size info is clearly listed. Descriptions are lengthy and tell you all you would need to know to make an informed purchase BUT if you do have a question you can post it for an answer. The reviews are helpful when someone actually explains WHY they gave the item a 5 star rating.

I love this app! They have cute games to play for in-store credit vouchers, which you can use with any of their sellers. They also offer great in-store coupons, sales, and gifts to their shoppers, such as no shipping and handling and/or no minimum spend limit. One of the games has been a little glitchy lately, but still playable. However, it hasn't effected the rest of their app.

I've been shopping Aliexpress for a good 5-6 years and I definitely feel confident that what I purchase will come and if a vendor thinks they will try to scam you, Aliexpress will be sure to give a full refund. I just wish there was a shorter time period allotted for vendors to get items to the buyers. Usually my items have come from 2 weeks up to 2 months. I've had a few come within a week of ordering and I've had some take 3 months. I recommend giving Aliexpress a try. 👌👌

5 orders in (I'd say 20 products) and so far so great. Delivery average about 9 days. Not bad considering the prices. Had 3 issues (1 my fault) but was promptly refunded with no hassle whatsoever. I consider that fair. People do need to keep in perspective the prices I believe. If you expect paying a cheap price to get a cheap product, then you will be more than satisfied from my experience. As in will it have all the features of something 30-50 bucks more? Probably not. But it will work

This is where storefronts source their goods, to include Amazon jungle as well as brick and mortar shops. I have been shopping for ebike conversion kits and found the best prices on AliExpress, go figure huh? I've also been shopping for a vacuum, and to my surprise, they had the same one I was eyeing on Amazon Jungle for the same price. Cut out the middle man and source it from the wholesalers! I'll definitely be using it for less urgent but desired items.

out of all the online shopping I've done, this is easily the one of which, for example, would sell the same item as another shopping company, but AliExpresses' would quite literally end up selling you a higher-quality product, in addition are still able to have much lower prices not just for the physical item being purchased but shipping as well. 👍💯😁🥳

Orders works well. Daily updates of processing, packing, enroute, customs clearance, and multiple (unchanged) delivery notifications is excessive. Only purpose seems to upsell.me more. Would appreciate an option for fewer specific notifications. I usually have four or five different vendors sending same multiple messages. I normally order once a month when I receive my funds.

Ok, the first time I ordered a product on Ali it never arrived. although I did receive a full refund, I had to order elsewhere and being able to use the item was delayed over a month. I didn't plan to use Ali again but saw an incredible deal on a boat motor and decided to give them another chance and absolutely no problem. Will definitely be checking with Ali for future needs.

The app itself is great. It's the seller's you take a change on. I've really only had one problem but it was resolved to my satisfaction. Lots of shops. Lots of sellers. Unlimited amount of merchandise. Great prices if you can wait a little longer for shipping. More than half the time shipping is free. If you're a shopper you have to check this out.

Really wish this app had dark mode, I like to browse on and off throughout the day and even check my shipping but the light theme hurts my eyes Lol. By the way be aware buying figurines, if its cheap its a bootleg unless you're fine with that, check reviews to make sure what you're buying matches the image! Shipping used to take 4+ weeks. Now with most items, I get it in less than a week. I am pretty sure this is because of the competition from temu(yay for competition). It has a better selection than temu for things I want, although still mostly lower end stuff. I hope more higher quality items that sell on taobao would sell on here.

This app runs circles around Amazon in both user friendliness and in tracking orders and leaving feedback! Update: Here I am 2 years later and as an Amazon loyalist, this app is still far superior to Amazon and other online retailers. The search filtering options alone show how Amazon filters push buyers into buying Amazon branded products, Sponsored listings, & products of higher price (a marketing method to increase profits). Unless I need a product , I always check Aliexpress before buying.

I've purchased several items & received everything. Otherwise, its nice to shop at.

Shipping may take longer than other places, but everything I have purchased has been amazing! I would say always check out the reviews and the seller rating before placing an order! I always make sure there are photo reviews that show what people have received before I go through with ordering and I think that's where a lot of people mess up. Just like with Amazon, reviews matter. Which also means, if you order a product, you should review it so others can see if it's worth buying or not! 💞

I really love this app it finds the things I am looking for at a fraction of the price I would pay at most places like Amazon . Thanks AliExpress! You guys do great. The only downfall I could say about it is shipping takes a while to get to you but I suppose that's the price you pay for such cheap items. Thank you either way. I still love this site. !!!⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I've been shopping with Aliexpress for 5 years or more and I love it. Never had any problems with damaged goods being replaced. Never had to return anything. Never been ripped off. Yes SOME products are not of high quality but you get that anywhere. Overall I am happy with the service and products. The only thing I do not like is some clothing items are cut extremely small and sizes are mislabeled at times. Anything that is cut small or mislabeled I pass on to family, friends or sell.

Ok, I have ordered off of many similar apps, and I have never been more happy with AliExpress. They actually send the product after payment is made, and to the correct address. They also provide you with a tracking number and a text to give you a 'heads up' that you're package has been put in the mail. Compared to other apps, this app is without a doubt, my favorite. One last thing, if you're worried about sending payment and not receiving? DON'T! They guarantee you're money! Hope this helps...

After nearly 100 orders, I've only ever had two issues. The first was an item that was rejected before the international transit, and the shop had me refunded within 24 hours. The only other issue was a single wrong item sent when I ordered 7 or 8 $1.99 items. I didn't even ask for a replacement because I ended up using it. The other 98+ orders have been perfect. I've ordered everything from socks and microfiber rags to a high end microscope for soldering, and everything has been excellent.

Great app once you realise paypal is best way to pay. Great product range at unbelievable prices. You have to read the details regarding what you are purchasing. Sometimes you need to purchase more than 1 color(part) to get the whole item. Make sure you choose correct size or options too. Still working well. I Would love to know how they can ship stuff half way around the planet at less than the walmart price.

I absolutely love this app! I've been using it for many months now and shipping isn't much longer than with Amazon.. Usually takes about a week for me. So all in all, this is a solid app with great products! I got my 3 kids 2 outfits each for $70 total including tax & shipping. I very highly recommend!

If you can wait for the shipping and if you don't mind it sometimes being a cheap product, this is perfect and it takes a while for shipping sometimes but that's the price you pay, they do a pretty great job, they always seem to take care of their customer order screw up, the one out of the many orders now that I have made that have been messed up but they take care of it right away. Just don't expect your product right away that's the main thing. Five star

SUGGESTION..... We need a way to compare similar item we have selected. Comparing price, features, shipping cost/methods, would be a great help since there are very many of the SAME EXACT products. Great app. Definitely enjoy the options. Easy to use. A lot of shopping options. Haven't noticed any issues with the app. As far as tracking goes I use the tracking number with USPS and get better tracking that way. Overall have been pleased with all the purchases. Again the app itself is fine, no issues. Problems with sellers is not an app issue, it's a seller issue. As far as the app goes it works just fine.

Very fast and easy to use, I find myself at time distracted by all the items they have and have found the same items on other sites that are either doubled or tripled the price. But of course nothing is perfect and what you are saving in money you are trading in time. Basically alot of affordable priced items but the wait for your item can take up to a month or more. Though the sellers are all fairly good and you tend to get your items earlier then what is suggested.

10/10 recommend 🫶 I've been using AliExpress for a few years now and I haven't had any bad experiences. The user-friendly interface makes navigating both the app and website a breeze while browsing through the multitude of products, which by far exceeded my expectations. Anything I may want or need, I know I'll find it on AliExpress with the best deals and the lowest prices!!

Very surprised on the quality of products you get from here! I'm glad it's super reasonable and it's painless finding what you like, add to cart and pay from there. They accept PayPal as well and you have folders to organize your wishlist. I really would have liked the reviews for products to be put in more effort lol and sometimes the description makes sense or detailed. But things were accurate and turned out great for the most part!

Excellent app. It can crash from time to time, but that's to be expected. The UI is intuitive w/ simple to read page layout. It's like an old Sears catalog in a simple to use app. Excellent tracking of your orders even before it gets shipped out to you. You can search for products in the search bar or you can search w/ a picture of the product you're looking for. There's mini-games to win coins & coupons for use on your orders, plus many of the stores have coupons. There's always sales.

1st time purchasing from here and I really didn't know what to expect. Initially, I thought it would take months before I would receive my items but no they shipped my items right away and continued to update me with the date that my items were shipped, if there were any delays and they also sent me the tracking info. So glad I decided to order from you guys. Keep up the good work! I look forward to doing business with you again.

I've only received 4 items from this app. 2 were good. 2 were not. Arrived earlier than expected. I learned to order items from China. Shipping is cheaper! I use this app on a daily basis and I think it would be better if it had a message blocking setting. I've been buying from AliExpress for years now and it has been an excellent experience!!!! If I have an issue, they suggest that you reach out to the seller first. It's great if you don't mind waiting for what you want! The deals are great, but pay attention to the shipping price. Some say free, but that's for certain things. Read the description carefully and understand they're speaking the best English they know how wish isn't always clear. The reviews seem AI generated at times, but worth reading non the less!

I have purchased a lot of items from this app. Everything I have purchased I love. An you cant beat there prices. I can buy 5 things from this app, where as if I purchased it from a store one item would be the price of 5 from theirs. It has saved me a lot of money. The only down side to it is it can become very addicting. Overall I love the app and love there products and clothes. They have pretty much anything u would ever want. Huge variety.

Very good App. I think it's much better than Temu & Amazon. Sellers' on this app I basically the same. The only differences is via Amazon get things faster. But if you look at the positive side the prices are much cheaper. And then you get your package from AliExpress it is basically like you are getting a present with you never expected.

I absolutely love the AliExpress app. The app runs well and is user-friendly. I like that you can message the seller in regard to a package with a saved record of the correspondence. I personally think it should be easier to reach out to a customer service representative with AliExpress. Otherwise, I am very impressed with AliExpress and their app.

Great App! Cheap stuff and real! Specially when your trying to get phone chargers and other simple accessories cheap! Only problem is shipping takes awhile. Like two weeks to a whole month sometimes. I rather pay for a nylon usb cord thats 9-feet long for a $1.88 free shipping, then go to the store and pay $20.

Very easy to navigate and very easy to search. Even if you search up something obscure, it's very rare to get "no results" due to their amazing programming. The items that do show up also are almost always related to the search in one way or another. Products range in quality and pricing but overall most sellers are very reliable, and if they aren't the refund system is extremely easy to use and very helpful! A lot of the items I would buy on Amazon are sold by the original sellers on here.

Love this app!! It is the best place to find so far for me flashlights and headlamps as well as phone chargers I also bought an ocedar mop and bucket for a great deal off of here a whole lot cheaper than buying in a retail store!!! There's multiple things you can buy on this app it seems like everything runs together sometimes and if you search a certain thing sometimes it just doesn't pull it up they may have it or may not but it doesn't pull up just that thing you're looking for every time!

This app is very legit. Lots of items/products at a unbeatable price! I've made numerous orders and they're always on time with delivery. After placing my orders, they always email me about my orders & keep updated as well! It'll take at least almost a week and a half for my orders to be delivered. Overall, I love this app & will definitely recommend this app to anyone. Big 5 stars for this app!! 😁

I shop here all the time, mainly for clothes and cute novelty items. Just buy things with reviews and find good sellers and then it is all okay 😌. Don't recommend buying technology. Sometimes it's a little buggy but it is okay. The dispute system is okay and has worked for me, never close a dispute when a seller asks you too.

Love this app. If you don't mind waiting a bit for shipping, there are some great deals. I once had an issue with some batteries I got from one of the sellers on this app, Aliexpress customer service was excellent, I was refunded in full and didn't have the hassle of sending junk back, etc. The complaints on the ratings for this app are primarily user error, or unrealistic expectations. I give 5/5 stars all day.

Its a legit app. It just takes 3 weeks or longer to get yout order but thats to be expected with customs. The prices more than make up for it.
